disclosures.title: 2026 enterprise cloud and cybersecurity expansion
disclosures.body_text: Mobily plans to expand enterprise leadership through next-generation cloud, cybersecurity and managed services.

disclosures.title: 2026 digital infrastructure monetization
disclosures.body_text: Mobily plans to monetize data-center, subsea-cable and network-API infrastructure investments.

disclosures.title: 2026 AI and automation program
disclosures.body_text: Mobily plans to advance AI and automation to improve efficiency, agility and customer intelligence.

disclosures.title: 2026 sustainable network growth
disclosures.body_text: Mobily plans smart-power solutions and ESG-led sustainable growth across its network.

disclosures.title: 2026 future-ready talent development
disclosures.body_text: Mobily plans to develop Saudi talent in high-demand digital fields.

disclosures.title: 2026 B2B and digital portfolio goals
disclosures.body_text: Mobily plans to grow B2B share in SMEs and large enterprises and expand digital ICT and cloud portfolios.

disclosures.title: Cybersecurity risk
disclosures.body_text: Mobily classifies vulnerabilities, geopolitical pressure and rising hacktivism as a stable/high principal risk, mitigated through NCA and ISO controls and employee training.

disclosures.title: Supply-chain risk
disclosures.body_text: Mobily identifies regional geopolitics and logistics disruption as supply-chain risk, mitigated by continuity planning, geographic diversification and monitoring.

disclosures.title: Data-privacy risk
disclosures.body_text: Mobily classifies technology-enabled access, hacktivism and stricter privacy mandates as a stable/high principal risk.

disclosures.title: Dual-fiber and submarine-cable risk
disclosures.body_text: Mobily identifies construction, difficult terrain and climate as cable risks, mitigated with route diversity, maintenance and backup connectivity.
